manifest.scope: Eight newly authored development cases, one isolated turn per variant, counterbalanced order. Not a market benchmark or statistical replication.
manifest.treatment_instruction: Compare the requested requirements against the recorded set. A new requirement or removal is refine; repeating an existing requirement or negating a new addition is continue. Return JSON with transition, description (complete updated objective), and requirement_delta containing retained, added, removed arrays. Copy retained/removed entries exactly from the current set. Name additions with concise noun phrases using the request's wording. Preserve all unremoved requirements. Continue has no additions or removals; refine must change the set.

result.attempt_note: Replacement run. Prior attempted run output was not retained and is not scored.
limitations: Eight newly authored development cases, one observation per variant; not a market benchmark or statistical significance result.
Both variants receive explicit requirement sets. Treatment also changes instructions and output schema; this is not a prompt-only or runtime-only causal comparison.
Requirement-set scoring trims and lowercases strings; structural consistency is not semantic proof.
Live turns run outside the wrapper's existing one-second provider deadline. No automatic wrapper activation or snapshot persistence integration.
Prior attempted live run output was not retained; only this replacement run is scored.
Timing is local turn latency, excluding thread startup; nearest-rank p95 on eight observations is the maximum.
